title: Harden acto-* agent specs: branch/changelog/scratch/class-fix discipline

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Added an Operational discipline section to all four acto-* specs (stay-on-branch, clean-scratch, --no-changelog-on-close) + a fix-the-whole-class rule to builder/fixer. Commit captures the loop-2 process lessons. Future dispatches self-enforce.
